description: February 13 birthday meaning: Aquarius decan 3, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a February 13 birthday falls in Aquarius, in the third decan, with Uranus as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aquarius is fixed and air.

sections.heading: February 13 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Thirteen becomes 4, the number of steady work, and on February 13 that diligence meets Aquarius at roughly twenty-four degrees. Venus as decan sub-ruler adds a love of harmony. The tradition describes a reliable friend to the group: inventive, fair-minded and willing to do the unglamorous admin that keeps a shared vision alive.

On February 13 the Sun usually sits at about 24° Aquarius, in the third decan, where Venus is the sub-ruler alongside Uranus. Venus, ruler of Libra, softens the closing decan of Aquarius, from about February 9 to February 18. The sign's humanitarian streak picks up warmth, charm and a strong sense of fairness. Mid-February birthdays are often described as friendly idealists who care about justice as much as innovation and enjoy art, design and collaboration. Relationships tend to be valued as partnerships of equals. Venus can make them keen to keep the peace even when a principle is at stake. When this decan pairs its vision with its natural grace, it can make change feel welcoming rather than disruptive.

sections.heading: February 13 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 13th, your birthday compound is 13, reducing as 1 + 3 = 4. Some numerologists treat 13 as a karmic debt number, read not as bad luck but as a call to patient, consistent effort. The 1 adds initiative and the 3 adds imagination, and both feed into the 4's practical discipline. Those born on this day are frequently described as hard workers with an inventive streak, able to rebuild something better after it has fallen apart. The day number is secondary, yet in the 13 it often surfaces as a stubborn, constructive determination.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one February 13 birthday to the next: it is 4 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on February 13: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 13 is the 44th day of the year. By February 19, 6 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Pisces.

For the Chinese zodiac, February 13 sits inside the Lunar New Year window: in 97 of the 121 years from 1924 to 2044 the new year has already begun by this date, so check the year before choosing an animal. Well-known people born on February 13 include William Shockley (1910), Robbie Williams (1974) and Ivan Krylov (1769).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 13?
faq.answer: February 13 is Aquarius in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Aquarius, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 13?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 13 the Life Path is 4 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 13th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 13?
faq.answer: February 13 is a date where the Chinese animal genuinely depends on the year. Lunar New Year had arrived by this date in 97 of 121 years between 1924 and 2044; in the others the birth belongs to the previous animal.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 13?
faq.answer: February 13 is also the birthday of William Shockley (1910), Robbie Williams (1974) and Ivan Krylov (1769). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
